intent: Make the coordinator, Banking, and Shipping prompts natively executable by ChatGPT chat Agents using GitHub Connect for repository control and the already-proven authorized Google Drive path for large binary handoff.
rationale_summary: CAP-0009 already owns remote Git/CI continuity and the proven ChatGPT/Drive data plane, CAP-0010 owns isolated reservation/cursor routing, and CAP-0006 owns blind model-memory work without Evidence search. This change removes local-Agent assumptions and reuses those owners directly instead of introducing a second execution hierarchy.
